verses.text: Who is this coming from Edom, from the city of Bozrah, with clothes stained red? Who is this, dressed in splendor, marching forward in his great strength? "It is I, the one who speaks what is right, mighty to save."
Why are your clothes red, like those of someone who stomps grapes in a winepress?
"I have stomped the winepress alone. No one from the nations was with me. I stomped on them in my anger and trampled them in my fury. Their blood splashed on my clothes and stained all my clothing.
For the day of paying back was in my heart, and the year for rescuing my people had come.
I looked, but there was no one to help. I was shocked that no one gave support. So my own arm brought salvation, and my own fury held me up.
I trampled the nations in my anger. I made them drunk in my fury and poured their blood out on the ground."

I will tell of the LORD's faithful love. I will praise the LORD for all he has done for us, for the many good things he has done for the people of Israel, because of his mercy and his great faithful love.
He said, "Surely they are my people, children who will not betray me." So he became their Savior.
In all their suffering, he suffered too, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and mercy he rescued them. He lifted them up and carried them all the days of long ago.
But they rebelled and made his Holy Spirit sad. So he turned and became their enemy, and he himself fought against them.

Then his people remembered the days of long ago, the days of Moses. They asked, "Where is the one who brought them through the sea, with the shepherd of his flock? Where is the one who put his Holy Spirit among them,
who sent his glorious power to be at the right hand of Moses, who divided the waters before them to make an everlasting name for himself,
who led them through the depths? Like a horse in open country, they did not stumble.
Like cattle going down into a valley, the Spirit of the LORD gave them rest." This is how you led your people to make a glorious name for yourself.
Look down from heaven and see, from your holy and glorious home. Where is your burning love and your mighty power? Your tender love and mercy are being held back from us.
But you are our Father, even if Abraham does not know us and Israel does not recognize us. You, LORD, are our Father. Your name from long ago is Our Redeemer.
LORD, why do you let us wander from your ways and let our hearts become so hard that we do not respect you? Come back for the sake of your servants, the tribes that belong to you.
Your holy people owned your holy place for only a little while. Now our enemies have trampled it down.
We have become like people you never ruled, like those who were never called by your name.
